title: Magnetic localization and spectral asymmetry of a charged particle at a screw dislocation
summary: We study a charged particle moving outside a spiral (screw) dislocation in a uniform magnetic field. Although the geometry is locally Euclidean, its global screw identification couples the conserved axial and azimuthal quantities through the combination \(\mathcal{J}=\ell-βk\) After eliminating the cyclic coordinates, the radial motion is governed by an inverse-square term determined by $\mathcal{J}$ and a harmonic confining term generated by the magnetic field.
